import sys
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def num(x, nd=2):
    return round(float(x), nd)


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])
    facts = []

    def add(entity, metric, period, value, formula):
        if value is None or (isinstance(value, float) and not np.isfinite(value)):
            return
        facts.append({
            "entity": str(entity),
            "metric": metric,
            "period": period,
            "value": float(value),
            "formula": formula,
        })

    rev_tw = df["Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_lw = df["Revenue_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_ly = df["Revenue_LY"].sum(skipna=True) if df["Revenue_LY"].notna().any() else np.nan

    # ---- Totals ----
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "TW", num(rev_tw), "sum(Revenue_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LW", num(rev_lw), "sum(Revenue_LW)")
    if pd.notna(rev_ly):
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LY", num(rev_ly), "sum(Revenue_LY) over rows with LY data")
    if rev_lw and rev_lw != 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "WoW", num((rev_tw - rev_lw) / rev_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100")
    if pd.notna(rev_ly) and rev_ly != 0:
        mask = df["Revenue_LY"].notna()
        tw_m = df.loc[mask, "Revenue_TW"].sum()
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "YoY", num((tw_m - rev_ly) / rev_ly * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100 on rows with LY data")

    add("TOTAL", "units", "TW", num(df["Units_TW"].sum(), 0), "sum(Units_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "units", "LW", num(df["Units_LW"].sum(), 0), "sum(Units_LW)")
    u_lw = df["Units_LW"].sum()
    if u_lw:
        add("TOTAL", "units", "WoW", num((df["Units_TW"].sum() - u_lw) / u_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Units_TW) - sum(Units_LW)) / sum(Units_LW) * 100")
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "TW", num(df["Orders_TW"].sum(), 0), "sum(Orders_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "LW", num(df["Orders_LW"].sum(), 0), "sum(Orders_LW)")
    o_lw = df["Orders_LW"].sum()
    if o_lw:
        add("TOTAL", "orders", "WoW", num((df["Orders_TW"].sum() - o_lw) / o_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Orders_TW) - sum(Orders_LW)) / sum(Orders_LW) * 100")

    # ---- Top entities by revenue ----
    top = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW"]).sort_values("Revenue_TW", ascending=False)
    for _, r in top.head(3).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", num(r["Revenue_TW"]), "Revenue_TW for this product")
        share = r["Share_Pct"] if pd.notna(r.get("Share_Pct")) else (
            r["Revenue_TW"] / rev_tw * 100 if rev_tw else np.nan)
        add(r["Entity"], "share", "TW", num(share, 1), "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")
        add(r["Entity"], "rank", "TW", num(r["Rank"], 0), "rank by Revenue_TW (1 = highest)")

    if len(top) >= 3 and rev_tw:
        add("TOTAL", "share", "TW", num(top.head(3)["Revenue_TW"].sum() / rev_tw * 100, 1),
            "sum(top 3 Revenue_TW) / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")

    # ---- WoW movers (absolute revenue change) ----
    d = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW"]).copy()
    if not d.empty:
        d["abs_chg"] = d["Revenue_TW"] - d["Revenue_LW"]
        up = d.loc[d["abs_chg"].idxmax()]
        add(up["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(up["abs_chg"]),
            "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW (largest absolute weekly gain)")
        dn = d.loc[d["abs_chg"].idxmin()]
        if dn["Entity"] != up["Entity"]:
            add(dn["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(dn["abs_chg"]),
                "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW (largest absolute weekly decline)")

    p = df.dropna(subset=["WoW_Pct"])
    if not p.empty:
        b = p.loc[p["WoW_Pct"].idxmax()]
        add(b["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(b["WoW_Pct"], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100 (best WoW %)")
        w = p.loc[p["WoW_Pct"].idxmin()]
        if w["Entity"] != b["Entity"]:
            add(w["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(w["WoW_Pct"], 1),
                "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100 (worst WoW %)")

    # ---- YoY movers ----
    y = df.dropna(subset=["YoY_Pct"])
    if not y.empty:
        b = y.loc[y["YoY_Pct"].idxmax()]
        add(b["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", num(b["YoY_Pct"], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100 (best YoY %)")
        w = y.loc[y["YoY_Pct"].idxmin()]
        if w["Entity"] != b["Entity"]:
            add(w["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", num(w["YoY_Pct"], 1),
                "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100 (worst YoY %)")

    yl = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LY"]).copy()
    if not yl.empty:
        yl["ychg"] = yl["Revenue_TW"] - yl["Revenue_LY"]
        t = yl.loc[yl["ychg"].abs().idxmax()]
        add(t["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", num(t["ychg"]),
            "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY (largest absolute year-on-year swing)")

    # ---- Units / orders leaders ----
    if df["Units_TW"].notna().any():
        u = df.loc[df["Units_TW"].idxmax()]
        add(u["Entity"], "units", "TW", num(u["Units_TW"], 0), "max(Units_TW) across products")
    if df["Orders_TW"].notna().any():
        o = df.loc[df["Orders_TW"].idxmax()]
        add(o["Entity"], "orders", "TW", num(o["Orders_TW"], 0), "max(Orders_TW) across products")

    # ---- Smallest contributor ----
    if not top.empty:
        s = top.iloc[-1]
        add(s["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", num(s["Revenue_TW"]), "lowest Revenue_TW among products")

    print(json.dumps(facts[:25]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
